doctor.bio: Dedicated to compassionate, modern vision care in Bikaner. Specialized in phacoemulsification cataract assessment, precise refraction, glaucoma management, and comprehensive anterior segment evaluations.

services.title: Comprehensive Eye Examination
services.description: Computerized automated refraction, slit-lamp bio-microscopy, intraocular pressure check, and visual acuity evaluation for patients of all ages.

services.title: Cataract Evaluation & IOL Assessment
services.description: Pre-operative optical biometry, keratometry, modern intraocular lens counseling, and micro-incision phacoemulsification evaluation.

services.title: Glaucoma Screening & Pressure Checks
services.description: Goldmann applanation tonometry, central corneal thickness assessment, optic disc evaluation, and long-term intraocular tension monitoring.

services.title: Retina & Diabetic Eye Screening
services.description: Dilated funduscopy, diabetic retinopathy risk evaluation, hypertensive retinopathy screening, and timely retinal referral coordination.

services.title: Refractive Error & Pediatric Vision
services.description: Pediatric vision screening, amblyopia management, accurate spectacle prescription, and progressive myopia counseling.

services.title: Dry Eye & Computer Vision Care
services.description: Tear breakup time diagnostics, ocular surface soothing therapy, digital eye strain mitigation, and lubricating regimen guidance.
